messages.subject: Project Skylark - royalty projection model
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

For our internal forecasting, can you confirm the royalty mechanics are captured correctly? I've attached the model finance built - it steps the rate from 4.5% to 3.0% once cumulative royalties pass £12m, and tops up to the £750k minimum from Year 3. Want to be sure it matches the executed agreement before we book it.

Grace

messages.subject: RE: Project Skylark - royalty projection model
messages.plaintextBody:
Grace,

Confirmed - the model matches clauses 4.2 to 4.4 of the executed licence: 4.5% to 3.0% step-down at £12m cumulative royalties, £750k annual minimum creditable against running royalty from Year 3, plus the £1.5m and £2.0m milestones. Looks right.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
